done_when: docs/specs/one-chat-approval.md is confirmed by the owner and on the roadmap as FORGE-ONECHAT-1

findings.body: Adding this plan makes the branch fail Forge's existing PR document gate. `src/forge/story.py:332–334` requires every changed story plan to have a matching approval in its story state, but the added `.factory/stories/FORGE-ONECHAT-1/story.json` contains only start/read steps and no approval. `src/forge/prcheck.py:60–62` refuses the PR on that mismatch. The plan, its cold-read notes and its story state are also outside this task's three allowed paths and are unnecessary to confirm and link the spec. Keep those story-planning artifacts on the parent story branch so this spec task can merge independently.
findings.title: Keep the unapproved story plan out of this spec-only branch

why: The owner wants every Forge repo's stories approved from one main chat, but the approval hook only sees stories in the repo the chat started in
